text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I heard that voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERBYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How many times have I been encouraged by her cheerful voice
as she earnestly looks ahead? But—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On this day, that voice sounded truly terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't it working...?
Why... am I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Unfortunately, I lost, though.

However, Biwa Hayahide falls silent once more.
...What should I say to her next?
As I searched for the right words—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~~!
Winning Tiiicket-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Yes! Weekly Winner's Step here!! You'll let me interview you today, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course!!
Sorry for turning you down before!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all!
So, how did the Derby go?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It was the absolute best!
Everyone was cheering so loud, going 'Whoaaaa!'
It really felt like a dream... No, even better.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was even more amazing than a dream!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Though we did lose.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I worked super hard, you know.
Because I wanted to win no matter what.
I trained so, so much with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I really, really wanted to win...! I wanted to win so badly...!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: ...Shall we head back to the waiting room?
...Wanna head back to the waiting room?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Even after returning to the waiting room,
Biwa Hayahide remained silent.
Just like back during the Satsuki Sho...

Biwa Hayahide's shoulders flinch.
It seems she has her own thoughts on the matter as well.
choice_data_list: ...What have you been thinking since then?
...What have you been thinking since then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How do you always know? Right down to the exact time of "that moment."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...A thought crossed my mind while I was running.
A future where I lose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"To Taishin in the Satsuki Sho,
and to Ticket in the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even after anticipating countless scenarios and running simulations over and over...
these girls always bring out 'something'
that completely exceeds them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid. Of something elusive and unknown.
If it wasn't an oversight, but "something" forever out of reach...
Then what have I done to those girls...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And yet...!
choice_data_list: Then let's rethink what sets you apart from those two.

text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is an exceptionally clever Umamusume.
Clever enough to figure out a solution all on her own.
"...That is why, when faced with an obstacle, you try too hard to resolve it entirely within your own thoughts. But at times—you must direct your focus outward."
choice_data_list: Why don't you try copying what makes those two so amazing?
Why don't you try copying what makes those two so amazing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I hear 'to learn' and 'to imitate' share the same etymological root, so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Still, their strong points are completely different, aren't they?
That's precisely why in a race....”
choice_data_list: So when you're not racing, then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Other than... racing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Before the Satsuki Sho, I thought
Taishin's determination was 'incredible.'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket too... yeah,
her drive was "incredible" even before the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Why did I think that—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...I worked super hard, you know.
Because I really, really wanted to win.
I trained so, so hard with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...They had it. In those girls,
there was a 'will to become stronger.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A resolve unconcerned with what might happen.
Surely ready to sacrifice everything, even if it all breaks...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regarding what comes next, please do not fear.
I want you to push me through rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My body won't break.
I'm not like I was when I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I will never suffer defeat again...!
I will push myself even further...!

Even after returning to the academy from Tokyo Racecourse,
her incredible momentum showed no signs of fading.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will never... lose again...!
...Along with an abnormal obsession.

—The next goal, the 'Kikuka Sho',
would be the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown route.
